recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast portrait of a woman with voluminous curly hair against a textured, industrial red background featuring chains and wooden beams. The composition uses a vertical distressed title and a glowing horizontal subtitle, creating a gritty yet polished urban pop aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast red and black industrial backdrop
Vertical title text balanced by horizontal subtitle text
Warm skin tones and brown clothing contrasting with the vibrant red background glow
Industrial elements like chains and beams framing the central figure
coreInvariants: High-key lighting on the subject's face and torso

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, woman with arms raised framing her head, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large circular metal ring on the clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the circular ring and belt, then shifts left to the vertical title and across to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with texture, chains, and glowing light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and gold tones in the subject's hair, skin, and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the typography and the metal ring detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds, high value contrast between the white text and dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical title uses heavy, distressed stencil-like characters with irregular edges
Subtitle uses a rounded, lowercase script-like sans-serif with a soft outer glow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical letters are rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to stack vertically
Subtitle characters have a luminous neon-like halo effect

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over a dark vertical beam

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a gritty, large vertical stencil with a soft, glowing horizontal script.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main title
Distressed texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, broken-stroke look of the vertical title.
Provides the soft, circular skeleton needed for the glowing subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait of a woman with voluminous curly hair in a brown halter top, centered. The background should be a dark industrial setting with wooden beams and hanging chains, illuminated by a vibrant red textured glow from behind.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large vertical title on the left using a white distressed stencil font. Add a smaller horizontal subtitle in the bottom left using a white rounded font with a red outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the title text vertically oriented and distressed?
Does the subtitle have a visible red neon-like glow?
Is the background primarily red and black with industrial textures?
Is the subject's hair voluminous and well-lit?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red background glow
Amount of distress on the vertical font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red glow doesn't wash out the subject
Verify the industrial elements feel integrated into the depth
Confirm the white text pops against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion urban portrait with industrial textures, a dominant red/black palette, and a mix of distressed vertical and glowing horizontal typography.
